notas_originais: Succ. III, 12 ז' למקדש as a reminiscence of the Temple usages; Pes. 115 a. Ib. 116 a ז' לתפוח typical of the apple tree (Cant. VIII, 5; v. Sot. 11 b); ז' לטיט typical of the clay (which the Israelites had to tread). Ber. 2 b; Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 4, a. e. אע"פ שאין … ז' לדבר although there is no proof for it (in the Bible), there is a mnemonical allusion to it; a. fr.

Kidd. 31 b, a. e. זִכְרוֹנוֹ לברכה (abbr. ז"ל) of blessed memory, v. זָכַר. Y. Shek. II, 47 a top דבריהן הן זִכְרוֹנָן their words are their monument; Gen. R. s. 82 זִכְרוֹנֵיהֶם (pl.). R. Hash. 27 a ז' ליום ראשון typical of the first day of creation; a. fr.—Esp. a Biblical verse in which Divine remembrance is alluded to, citation of verses &c. R. Hash. IV, 6 ז' … של פורענות citation of remembrance … for evil. Ib. 32 b ז' של יחיד a verse treating of the remembrance by the Lord of an individual; a. fr.— Pl. זִכְרוֹנוֹת. Ber. 6 a ספר הז' the Divine records; a. fr.—Esp. Zikhronoth, that portion of the Musaf of the New Year’s Day which treats of Divine remembrance. R. Hash. IV, 5, sq.; a. fr.—Constr. זִכְרוֹנֵי, v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de זָכָר); genitais masculinos; sexo masculino.; o lado fino e pontiagudo de uma ferramenta dupla.; o princípio frutificante, germe, botão, olho ou estrofíolo (nas plantas); ponto de germinação (em ovos) etc., v. próximo w.—Y.
definicoes_originais: the thin and pointed side of a double tool.
the fructifying principle, germ, bud, eye or strophiole (in plants); germinating spot (in eggs) &c., v. next w.—Y.
the bony inside of an animal’s horn or hoofs, the bony projection over which the horny substance grows.
notas_originais: Y. Snh. X, 28 d bot.; Num. R. s. 20, end.—Ab. Zar. 44 a (expl. מפלצת, II Chr. XV, 16) כמין ז' a phallus. Men. 6 a תמות וז' בבהמה unblemished condition and male sex of sacrifices are required only of cattle. Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9 d צד ז' the male side of the hermaphrodite; מכח זַכְרוּתוֹ in as much as he is a male; a. fr.

Bets. 31 b ז' שלו the sharper side of a hatchet (used for splitting), opp. נקבות שלו the broader side. Cant. R. to I, 3 [read:] כאדם שמטביל זַכְרוּתוֹ של מכחול בים as much as one takes up when dipping the point of the painting staff into the paint bottle.

Sabb. VII, 9 d bot.; XII, 13 c bot. כדי ליטע זַכְרוּתָהּ של חיטה deep enough to plant the wheat grain up to its eye (so that it can take root). Y. Ter. X, end, 47 c ז' של חלמון that part of the yolk where germination sets in; ib. ז' של מוח the germinating point in the white of the egg (the more substantial and cohesive part).
R. Hash. 27 b. Y. Erub. I, 19 b bot. Bekh. 44 a (Tosef. ib. II (I), 2 הזָכָר). [Zeb. 63 a בזכרות, v. זוּטְרָא I.]

Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 3 אין מְזַלְּחִין את הבית וכ' (not החבית) one must not (on the Sabbath) sprinkle the house with any kind of sprinkling fluids.

R. s. 18 וליתן לו ז' and to give him the rod (appoint him an officer).—בעל הז' carrier of the rod (among the Romans Centurio, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.). Sabb. 145 b ובעלי ז' Ms. M. Lev. 665 מזדמיין) or you will pay &c. Ib. דילמא … דאנן מז' (Yalk. l. c. דאינון, corr. acc.) didst thou know that we are destined to lose &c.? Ib. דאינון מארסוון (Yalk. l. c. דאתון מזדמיין), v. אֲנַס.

definicoes_originais: (cmp. זמם I a. דמי) to think.
notas_originais: Denom. זִימְיוֹנָא.
, v. זִימְ'
, v. זְמָם I
, part. pass. of זְמַן.
Ned. 24 a.— Pl. זְמִינַיָּא. Targ. I Sam. IX, 22 (ed. Wil. זַמְנ', corr. acc.).
Y. Bicc. III, 65 d top ר' ז'.—Y. Kil. IX, 32 d top אבא בר זבינא; Y. Shek. V, beg. 48 c זמ'; Sabb. 112 b רבא בר זימונא ed. (Ms. M. זימנא); a. fr.
, v. זְמַר I
Esth. R. to III, 1 (Yalk. Esth. 1054 זמרי).
Y. Kil. VIII, 31 c top; Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a; a. e.
Cant. R. to II, 12. Sot. 35 a קרא לד"ת ז' he called the words of the Law songs (an entertaining secular study); v. זֶמֶר I.
זמיתא, P. Sm. 1134) [ foam,] name of a brine. Ber. 36 a; 40 b (Ms. F. זו'); Ned. 55 b זו'.

verbetes.glosa_atual: murmurar; meditar, planejar (principalmente no sentido maligno, cmp. דִּבָּה).; fazer de uma pessoa um זוֹמֵם, refutar testemunhas testemunhando um álibi, refutar.; ser refutado, ser declarado sujeito à lei de retaliação.; para refutar.
definicoes_originais: to mumble; to meditate, plan (mostly in an evil sense, cmp. דִּבָּה).
to make a person a זוֹמֵם, to refute witnesses by testifying to an alibi, to rebut.
to be refuted, to be declared liable to the law of retaliation.
notas_originais: — Part. זוֹמֵם planning evil, esp. (with ref. to Deut. XIX, 19) a) giving false testimony, amenable to the law of retaliation; b) rebutting witness. Tosef. Macc. I, 1 עד ז' a witness convicted of false testimony; a. fr.— Fem. זוֹמֶמֶת (sub. עדות). Macc. I, 9 נמצאת אחת מהן ז' if one evidence (of one set of witnesses) has been disproved; a. e.— Pl. זוֹמְמִין, זוֹמְמִים. Ib. 4 אין אלו ז' they do not come under the law of retaliation. Ib. נעשים ז' are declared amenable to the law &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. ib. I, 10 זוֹמְמֵיהֶן those witnesses on whose evidence they had been declared guilty of false testimony. Y. ib. I, beg. 31 a זוֹמְמָיו those who witnessed falsely against him. Tosef. Snh. VIII, 2 העדים וזוממיהן וזוֹמְמֵי זוממיהן the original witnesses and their refuters, and the refuters of their refuters; a. fr.
Macc. I, 5 if other witnesses came again והֵזֵימּוּם and rebutted them. Keth. 20 a, v. כָּחַשׁ; a. fr. Macc. I, 4 (5 a) שיזימו Bab. ed., read שיזומו, v. infra.

Snh. 10 a פלוני … והוּזַמּוּ if witnesses declared, This man did &c., and were declared guilty &c. Macc. 3 a הוּזַמְּנוּ וכ' we have been convicted &c. before that certain court, and made to pay. Ib. I, 4 עד שיִזּוֹמּוּ את עצמן (Ar. בעצמן, Bab. ed. שיזימו corr. acc.) unless an alibi is established against their own persons (not an alibi of any of the alleged actors in the case). Ib. 5 b עד שיזומו שניהם unless both of them are refuted; a. fr.
Part. מְזַמֵּם, pl. מְזַמְּמִין, contr. מְזַמִּים. Y. ib. I, 31 b top.— Part. pass. מְזוּמָּם one accused by false witnesses. Snh. VI, 2 אם היה יודע שהוא מ' if he knew that he was innocent.
Y. Macc. I, beg. 31 a נִזְדַּמְּמוּ = נִיזוֹמּוּ.

Gen. R. s. 81, beg. (ref. to זמות, Prov. XXX, 32) אם נִזְדַּמְּמוּ אחריך דברים וכ' (Yalk. Prov. 964 נִזְמְמוּ Nif.) if thou hast been slandered, put thy hand to thy mouth; v. זָמַם II.—Denom. זְמָם I.

verbetes.glosa_atual: = precedido. Olá. Targ. Y. Deut. XIX, 18 דמַזְמִין que refutam.; provar ser uma testemunha falsa.
definicoes_originais: = preced. Hif. Targ. Y. Deut. XIX, 18 דמַזְמִין who rebut.
to be proven a false witness.
notas_originais: —B. Kam. 73 b bot. דאפכינהו ואַזְמִינְהוּ they reversed their statement of the case and also testified to an alibi as to time and place.

Ib. 73 a כי מִתַּזְּמֵי אטביחה when they were proven false witnesses with reference to slaughtering; ואִיתַּזְּמוּ להו אגניבה and they are considered as false witnesses also with reference to stealing. Ib. אטביחה דקא מִיתַּזְּמֵי אִיתַּזּוּם as regards the testimony to slaughtering on which they were refuted, they are refuted; a. e.— Ithpe. אִתְּזוֹם. Macc. 3 b א' חד מינייהו against one of them an alibi was proven.

definicoes_originais: (cmp. צמם) to tie up, to muzzle (b. h. חָסַם).
notas_originais: Ber. 63 b (ref. to זמות, Prov. XXX, 32, v. preced. w.) אם ז' וכ' if he muzzles his mouth (is ashamed to ask his teacher), he will have to put his hand to the mouth (when he in turn is asked). Ter. IX, 3 לא זוֹמֵם he does not muzzle his animal (complies with the law, Deut. XXV, 4); a. e.— Part. pass. זָמוּם, f. זְמוּמָה; pl. זְמוּמִים, זְמוּמוֹת muzzled, prevented from grazing. Gen. R. s. 41. Pesik. R. s. 3. Gen. R. s. 59, end; a. e.—Denom. זְמָם II.
Targ. Y. II Gen. XIII, 7.
same. Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 4.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Itpe. אִתְזְמֵים (cmp. דמם) deve ser confundido.
definicoes_originais: , Ithpe. אִתְזְמֵים (cmp. דמם) to be confounded.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XXIX, 9 אִתְזְמִימוּ (ed. Wil. אִדְזַמִימוּ fr. דמם; absent in ed. Lag.; h. text השתעשעו, rendered by אשתגישו a. our w., of which one is a gloss). [For אדז' cmp. הִדַּקִּי s. v. דְּקַק.]

Macc. 2 b בגניבתו ולא בזְמָמוֹ ‘one is sold for theft’ (Ex. XXII, 2), but not for false testimony (which might eventually have caused the sale of the alleged thief); Y. Sot. III, end, 19 b; Tosef. Macc. I, 1 בזְמֵימוֹ.

Gen. R. s. 81 (play on זמות, Prov. XXX, 32, v. זָמַם I) אם חשבת … נוח לך ליתן ז' וכ' if thou hast planned to do a good deed …, it would have been better for thee to put a muzzle on thy mouth. Ib. s. 75 (ref. to זממו, Ps. CXL, 9) עשה לו ז' וכ' put a bit to Esaw (Rome); … ומהו ז' וכ' and what is the bit (to check Rome’s power) &c.?; Meg. 6 a bot. זְמָמוֹ אל תפק וכ' ‘do not loosen his bit’ (Ps. l. c.), that means Germania &c.— Pl. זְמָמִים, v. זְמוּם.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , também o anel ou bastão do camelo através do nariz e a cesta presa a ele.
definicoes_originais: , also the camel’s ring or staff through the nose and the basket fastened thereto.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XXXVII, 29. Targ. Ps. XXXII, 9; a. fr.—Sabb. 107 a, v. אִיכּוּ. Ib. 111 b, sq. קיטרא דקטרי בז' the loop which is made to fasten the camel’s basket to the ring; קיטרא דז' גופיה the (permanent) knot in the bit itself; v. אִיסְטְרִידָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: organizar, designar.; para convidar, esp. para uma refeição.; מְזוּמָּנִי Meu convidado (Israel); um. e.-b) designado, escolhido.; fazer com que se prepare, notifique.
definicoes_originais: to invite, esp. to a meal.
מְזוּמָּנִי My invited guest (Israel); a. e.—b) designated, chosen.
to cause to prepare, to notify.
to designate for use; v. הַזְמָנָה.
to meet, to come to hand (providentially); to join one’s self to.
to make an appointment for meeting one another.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 79 b; a. v. fr.— Part. pass. מְזוּמָּן, f. מְזוּמֶּנֶת; pl. מְזוּמָּנִים, מְזוּמָּנוֹת a) invited. Pesik. R. s. 41, end מי שהוא מ' לסעודה he who is invited to the feast. Ib. (expl. מקראי, Is. XLVIII, 1

Ber. 43 a הוא מ' לברכה he is the one designated (by the host) to say grace. Ab. Zar. 17 a מז' לחיי וכ' chosen for the bliss of futurity.—Snh. 102 a עת היא מ' וכ' there is a time designated for &c. Ib. יום מזומן (not עת היא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8); Yalk. Is. 330; ib. Jer. 287.—c) ready at hand, in one’s possession. B. Mets. 102 a; Sifré Deut. 227, a. e. כי יקרא פרט למ' ‘if it chance’ (Deut. XXII, 6) this excludes that which is at thy disposal (in thy court yard); a. e.—2) to appoint a meal in common, so as to say grace together; to preface the grace after meal by saying, Let us praise &c.; v. זִימּוּן. Ber. VII, 1 שלשה … חייבין לזַמֵּן if three dine together, they are bound to make an appointment for common grace. Ib. מְזַמְּנִין עליו common grace may be appointed by making him one of the party (offering him something to eat). Ib. אין מ' עליהן you cannot count them in (to make up the requisite number). Ib. 2 עד כמה מזמנין how much must one eat of the meal in order to be counted one of the company? Ib. 3 כיצד מ' how is the appeal for common grace made?; a. fr.
Dem. VII, 1 המַזְמִין את הבירו וכ' if one notifies his friend that he will dine with him (on the Sabbath).
Ber. 26 a הִזְמִינוֹ וכ' if he designated a building for &c.

Snh. 96 a אותו מלאך שנ' לו וכ' that angel who was commissioned to accompany Abraham. Ib. נ' לו רגלי אחד a footman was joined to him (to meet his challenge). Ab. Zar. 25 b ישראל שנ' לו וכ' (Ḥull. 91 a שנטפל) an Israelite whom a gentile joins on the road. Shebi. VII, 4 שנִזְדַּמְּנוּ להם וכ' who accidentally caught unclean animals; a. fr.
Pesik. R. s. 33, v. זִימּוּן.

verbetes.glosa_atual: convidar; nomear; convocar; preparar.; marcar uma refeição em comum, dar graças em comum.; mesmo.; como precedente. como precedente. Nithpa. Targ. Jó XXXIII, 23.
definicoes_originais: to invite; to appoint; to summon; to prepare.
to appoint a meal in common, to say grace in common.
as preced. as preced. Nithpa. Targ. Job XXXIII, 23.
notas_originais: — Part. pass. זְמִין ready, prepared. Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 2 (Y. זַמִין, זַמְיַן, incorr.).—Ib. XIX, 11; 15 זְמִינִין (Y. II מְזַמְנַן, v. infra).—V. זְמִינָא.

Targ. Mic. III, 5. Targ. Ex. XIX, 10; 14 (ed. Berl. זָמֵין, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 25); a. fr. [Ib. XXV, 22 ואִיזַמָן, ed. Berl. ואֵיזָמֵין, Y. אֵיזְמַן, Ithpe.].—M. Kat. 16 a מְזַמְּנִינָן ליה וכ' we summon him &c. Cant. R. to V, 13 ביומוי דזַמְּנִינָן וכ' (not דזמניין) in those my days when we invited two parties of scholars (for discussions).— Part. pass. מְזַמַּן (hebraism: מְזוּמָּן). Targ. Ps. LXXII, 17 (h. text ינון).— Pl. constr. מְזַמְּנֵי. Targ. Y. Num. I, 16 (h. text קריאי). [Ib. XXVI, 9 מנמנמי Ar., read מזמני; ed. מערעי).
Ber. 45 b ניהדר ונְזַמֵּן let us go back and agree (retrospectively) to make our meal a common one.

Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 7. Targ. I Sam. XVI, 3. Targ. Ex. XIX, 10 ותַזְ' some ed. v. supra; a. fr.—Ber. 50 b אַזְמוּן עלייהו they counted them in for common grace, v. preced. Pi.—Snh. 48 a דאַזְמְנֵיה וכ' which one designated for &c.—B. Bath. 58 a sq. אי אתי אינש מעלמא ומַזְמִין ליה לדינא Ms. M. (ed. incorr.) if any unknown man will come and sue him; a. fr.
—Targ. Y. II Gen. XIX, 31 למִיזְדַּמְנָא וכ' to join us in wedlock (cmp. זְוַג).—Targ. Am. III, 3; a. e.
Targ. Josh. VII, 13; a. e. [Targ. Y. II Gen. XXII, 8 יזדמן, read יְזַמֵּן.]—Contr. אִיזַּמֵּן, Ithpe. אִיזְּמִין, v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.); hora marcada, prazo, hora.; época festiva (cmp. מִקְרָא, מְאַרְעָא); ‘Z’man’, aquela seção da bênção na entrada de um Festival que se refere ao retorno da época festiva (שהחיינו והגיענו לזמן הזה…).
definicoes_originais: festive season (cmp. מִקְרָא, מְאַרְעָא); ‘Z’man’, that section of the benediction on the entrance of a Festival which refers to the return of the festive season (שהחיינו והגיענו לזמן הזה …).
notas_originais: Kidd. I, 7, a. fr. הז' גרמא, v. גְּרָמָא.—B. Kam. 113 a קובעים ז' וכ' we appoint (in the summons to appear before court) a Monday, Thursday and Monday in succession. Gitt. 72 a, a. fr. זְמַנּוֹ של שטר the date of the document.—Taan. 14 b, a. fr. בז' הזה in our days (after the dissolution of the Jewish common-wealth). Ib. הכל לפי הז' all depends on the season (whether it is advanced or retarded, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400). Ib. זְמַנָּהּ של רביעה the rainy season; a. v. fr.— Pl. זְמַנִּים. Meg. 2 a ז' הרבה various dates (for reading the Megillah).—בִּזְמַן שֶׁ־ in the case of, when, if. Erub. VI, 7 אימתי בז' וכ' in what case (is this said)? When they carry &c. Ib. 6 ומודים בז' וכ' they all agree that, if some of them &c.; a. v. fr.—בִּזְמַנּוֹ, בִּזְמַנָהּ &c. in its prescribed, due time; חוּץ לִזְמַנּוֹ &c. out of time, beyond its due time. Zeb. I, 1. Ib. II, 3; a. v. fr.

Pes. 102 b מדלא אמר ז' since he did not mention the benediction of Z’man, v. יקנה"ז. Succ. 48 a שמיני … ז' בפני עצמו the eighth day (of Succoth) … is a festive season for itself, requiring the insertion of Z’man; a. fr.— Pl. as above. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 c ג' ז' בבבל there are three festive seasons (idolatrous fairs) in Babylonia. Tosef. Ber. III, 13 חותם ברוך … והז' you must close with ‘Blessed be He … who sanctifies the Sabbath, Israel, and the Seasons.—[Snh. 101 a הקורא … שלא בזמנו he who cites a Biblical verse at a banquet out of its context (perverting its sense for lascivious purposes); Treat. Kallah beg.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. O. Gen. XVIII, 14 (Y. ז' חגא, h. texto מועד). Ib. II, 23 הדא ז' desta vez (h. texto הפעם); um. frag.—Targ. Jer. XVIII, 7, 9 ז'… וז' em um momento… em outro momento.—Ḥull. 105 b ליקבע לי מר ז' וכ' estabeleceu-me um prazo e eu pagarei. M. Ka
notas_originais: Targ. O. Gen. XVIII, 14 (Y. ז' חגא, h. text מועד). Ib. II, 23 הדא ז' this time (h. text הפעם); a. fr.—Targ. Jer. XVIII, 7, 9 ז' … וז' at one time … another time.—Ḥull. 105 b ליקבע לי מר ז' וכ' set me a term, and I shall pay. M. Kat. 16 a דקבעינן ז' that (in legal summons) a date is fixed for appearing in court. Ib. ז' בתר ז' one term after the ofther (in case of failing to appear on the first summons). Hag. 4 b אזיל בלא זִימְנֵיה dies before his destined time; a. v. fr.—B. Bath. 73 b, a. fr. ז' חדא once upon a time (introducing a story).— Pl. זִמְנִין, זִי'. Targ. Ex. XXIII, 17; a. e.—Zeb. 94 b, a. fr. ז' סגיאין many times.—ז'—ז' at times … at other times. Ber. 20 b, a. fr.—מַשְׁכֵּן זִימְנָא = h. אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד. Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 43; a. fr.—Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 4 זִמְנָיִךְ = משכני זי'.—Targ. Jer. XLVII, 6 לבית ז' to thy destined home (the sheath; h. text הֵרָגְעִי!).—[Targ. Ps. CXLI, 4 בזמן משתיהון Ms (ed. בזמר בית מ') at their appointed banquets, v. preced. wds.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh) beliscar; podar; cortar.; para ser podado, trnsf. ser controlado, enervado, derrotado.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to nip; to prune; to cut.
to be pruned, trnsf. to be checked, unnerved, defeated.
notas_originais: Sabb. 73 b זוֹמֵר וצריך וכ' if one trims a tree (on the Sabbath) for making use of the wood. Snh. 26 a כהן וזומר (not וזמר) a priest is he, and he prunes the vine (in the sabbatical year)!; a. fr.

Cant. R. to II, 12 (ref. to זמיר ib.) הגיע זמנה של ערלה שתִּזָּמֵר the time for pruning the preputium (circumcision) has come (v. Ex. R. s. 19); הגיע … שיִזָּמֵרוּ the time has come for the Egyptians to be checked; Pesik. Haḥod., p. 50 a; Pesik. R. s. 15.—Lev. R. s. 9, beg. Akhan is named Zimri (I Chr. II, 6, cmp. with Josh. VII, 24) שנִזְמְרוּ … על ידו because through him the Israelites were unnerved (Josh. VII, 5); a. e.
Y. Shebi. IV, 35 a חמא חד אַ' וכ' (not איז') saw one prune &c. (in the Sabbatical year).

verbetes.glosa_atual: formigar, fazer música, cantar.; cantar louvores.; revisar uma lição de canto recitativo (v. זִמְרָה).
definicoes_originais: to review a lesson in recitative chant (v. זִמְרָה).
notas_originais: V. זֶמֶר.

Cant. R. to II, 16 הוא זִמְּרַנִי … זִמַּרְתִּיו (or זְמָרַנִי, זְמַרְתִּיו) He praised me, and I &c.—Gen. R. s. 91, end (expl. מזמרת, Gen. XLIII, 11) דברים שהן מְזַמְּרִין וכ' things which men praise all over the world.
Snh. 99 b top זַמֵּר בכל יום chant every day; Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 8 זַ' בי תדירה זַ' (the Law says) review me steadily &c.; ib. Par. IV (III), 7; cmp. גְּמָרָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Pa. זַמֵּיר mesmo; cantar.; cantar uma sátira, ridicularizar.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. XVIII, 50; a. e.—Sot. 48 a זַמְּרי גברי וכ' when men sing and women respond.
Targ. Lam. III, 14.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Hif. הִזְמִיר (cmp. זְמוֹרָא) para parecer azulado.
definicoes_originais: , Hif. הִזְמִיר (cmp. זְמוֹרָא) to look bluish.
notas_originais: Y’lamd. to Num. XXV, 14, quot. in Ar. (play on זִמְרִי) עד שה' בשרו כביצה מוזרת until his flesh (through his lewdness) had the color of a smashed (rotten) egg; (cmp. Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 2, Num. R. s. 21, beg., Snh. 82 b—where our w. is omitted).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זָמַר II) música, canto; כלי ז' (ou sub. כלי) instrumento musical.
definicoes_originais: (זָמַר II) music, song; כלי ז' (or sub. כלי) musical instrument.
notas_originais: Sot. 48 a בארבעה מיני ז' to the music of four instruments. Y. ib. VII, 21 c top לעז לז' Greek is adapted for song; Y. Meg. I, 71 b bot.—Snh. 101 a ועושה אותו כמין ז' and treats it (a verse of Song of Songs) like a (secular) song; Yalk. Prov. 953; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זָמַר I; cmp. זמרה, Gen. XLIII, 1; frutas, (uvas etc.), sobremesa.
notas_originais: Y. Pes. X, 37 d bot. (expl. אפיקומין) מיני ז' various dessert fruits (Bab. ib. 119 b תמרים וכ'; Tosef. ib. X, 11 אגוזים וכ').
Kel. XVI, 7 מרכוף של ז', v. מַרְכּוֹף. Yalk. Lam. 1001.

verbetes.glosa_atual: – Pl. זַמָּרַיָּא. Targ. Koh. II, 8.—Fem. por favor. זַמַּרְיָתָא. Ib.
notas_originais: — Pl. זַמָּרַיָּא. Targ. Koh. II, 8.—Fem. pl. זַמַּרְיָתָא. Ib.

verbetes.glosa_atual: —(זַיְינֵי) זְנֵי ז' = (כְּלֵי) מִינֵי זֶמֶר instrumentos musicais.
definicoes_originais: —(זַיְינֵי) זְנֵי ז' = (כְּלֵי) מִינֵי זֶמֶר musical instruments.
notas_originais: Dan. III, 5; a. e.—Targ. Koh. II, 8.—Targ. Ez. XXXIII, 32 זְמַר אבובין flute-music.— Pl. זְמָרַיָּא. Targ. Lam. V, 14.—Ib. III, 63 זְמָרֵיהוֹן object of their derisive songs, v. זְמַר II.

Gitt. 7 a ז' מנא לן וכ' how is it proved that music (at banquets, after the destruction of the Temple) is forbidden? Ib. ז' דמנא instrumental music, ז' דפומא vocal music. Sot. 48 a ז' בביתא וכ' music in the house—destruction at the threshold. Ib. בטיל ז' prohibited musical entertainments.—Sabb. 118 b פסוקי דז' verses of praise (Ps. CXLVIII a. CL; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200).— Pl. זִמְרִין, זִי'. Y. Meg. III, 74 a bot. הוה דמיך וקאים בזי' used to go to bed and rise with music.—V. זִמְרָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Zimra, pai de R. Yosé, v.
definicoes_originais: Zimra, father of R. Yosé, v. יוֹסֵי.
notas_originais: Keth. 96 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (σμάραγδος) smaragd, esmeralda, cristal colorido (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
definicoes_originais: (σμάραγδος) smaragd, emerald, colored crystal (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XXV, 12; a. fr. (in the sense of a precious stone [v. next w.], and as crystal or spar of copper mine).— Pl. h. זְמַרְגְּדִין. Lev. R. s. 2 (precious stones).
Targ. Y. II Ex. XXVIII, 19, v. אִזְמַרְגַּד.
, v. זְמֹוֹרָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זָמַר II) canto ao recitar lições talmúdicas.
definicoes_originais: (זָמַר II) chant on reciting Talmudic lessons.
notas_originais: Meg. 32 a (some ed. זימרא); Treat. Sof’rim III, 10.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (n. h.) pr. n. m. Zinri, morto por Finéias (Num. XXV, 14).
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Zimri, slain by Phinehas (Num. XXV, 14).
notas_originais: Snh. 82 b, a. e., v. זָמַר III. Y. Taan. III, 66 c bot. כמה ז' וכ' how mani Zimris (lewd men) are in our days!; a. fr.
, v. זַמָּרָא
gent. pl. (denom. of זמתא = זִמָּה) Zimthané (schemers). Targ. Y. Deut. II, 20 (Targ. O. חשבני; h. text זמזמים).

זן qualitas, modus, P. Sm. 1138, sq.; cmp. זֶה, a. מִין a. מַה) quality, nature; kind, species. Targ. Gen. I, 11 לִזְנֵיהּ after its kind. Targ. Lev. XI, 14 לִזְנָהּ; a. v. fr.—Ber. 32 a (prov.) מלי כרסיה זנא בישא Ar. (ed. זְנֵי בישי) filled stomachs are a bad sort (plenty is tempting).— Pl. זְנֵי, זֵינֵי. Targ. Gen. I, 21; a. fr.—Dan. II, 5, v. זְמָרָא.—B. Kam. 16 b (expl. זנים, II Chr. XVI, 14) זני זני Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. זיני) various species.
Sabb. 156 a.— Pl. זַנָּאִין. Targ. Jer. IX, 1; a. e.—Targ. Ez. XXIII, 45 (h. text נֹאֲפֹת!).

Bekh. VI, 9 זְנַב הגדי the tail of a kid; a. fr.—Yoma 41 b זְ' לשון the tail-end (fringes) of the band. Erub. 18 a (ref. to צלע, Gen. II, 22) ז' it means the tail (with which Adam was originally created). Kil. IV, 6 ואחת יוצאה ז' and one vine projects like a tail. Ukts. I, 3 ז' של אשכול the skeleton of the cluster of grapes (the thin branches), opp. to יד, the stem; a. fr.—Trnsf. the last, least. Ab. IV, 15, v. אֲרִי.—Euphem. membrum virile. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 10 (expl. ויזנב, Deut. XXV, 18) הכה אותן מכת ז' Amalek mutilated them by cutting off &c.; Pesik. Zakh., p. 27 a; Pesik. R. s. 12; Num. R. s. 13; v. זְמוֹרָה.—Denom.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Pi.; (v. Ukts. I, 3 quot. in precedente. w.) cortar os ramos extremos da videira, aparar.; para atacar, force uma passagem.
definicoes_originais: (v. Ukts. I, 3 quot. in preced. w.) to cut off the extreme branches of the vine, to trim.
notas_originais: Shebi. IV, 6 המְזַנֵּב בגפנים he who trims grape-vines.—Trnsf. ז' באשכולות [ to thin the clusters,] to diminish the scholars by persecution (v. אֶשְׁכּוֹל). Gen. R. s. 42; Lev. R. s. 11; a. e.
Gen. R. s. 74 בקש לזַנְּבָן Joab wanted to force his passage through their territory; Yalk. Sam. 147.
, v. דַּנְבָא
Y. Ter. VIII, 46 b bot. ז' מלכתא (not מלכותא).
, v. זִינְ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Targ. Não pode. III, 9, leia-se: זַנְבְּלִיגָא = זַמְבְּלִיגָא.
notas_originais: , Targ. Cant. III, 9, read: זַנְבְּלִיגָא = זַמְבְּלִיגָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ζιγγίβερις, zingiber) uma planta de especiarias árabe, prob. ruivo.
definicoes_originais: (ζιγγίβερις, zingiber) an Arabian spice plant, prob. ginger.
notas_originais: Yoma 81 b; Ber. 36 b (v. Ms. M. in Rabb. D. S. a. l.), v. הִימַלְתָּא.
of זקק, cmp. זִיקָא III; for inserted נ cmp מזדנדזין s. v. זעזע) jailer. Taan. 22 a ז' אנא Ar. (ed., a. Ar. ed. Koh. זַנְדּוּקָנָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50; Ms. M. בְּדִיקְנָאָה) I am a jailer.
